towns.name: Hoshino Fortress
towns.summary: Hoshino Fortress (79.4N 42.1W, north-west Northern Osteth) is the realm of the Materialized Hoshino Kei, added with The Risen Princess: a tier-8 hunting ground of spectral samurai, bushi, archers, mages and golem samurai, with quest-givers at the Royal Tent (80.7N 43.0W). A colossal Sho fortress crowns a plateau (base z 172): a grid of courtyards behind 31 m walls with red-railed parapets, gate houses to z 235.6 and pagoda towers 55-63 m tall with green, yellow and red tiered roofs; the courtyards hold tombstones, pebble mounds and pedestal arches, the Venerable Mausoleum portal in the first courtyard and the Falatacot Temple portal behind the middle gate. North of the fortress floats the Hoshino Tower (the old Floating Spectral Tower): a 61 x 30 m four-storey Sho hall hovering at z 172-202, 60-120 m above the ground, flanked by two floating blue cathedral spires and wrapped in 21 blue spectral-fog emitters. 100 m below on the southern slope lie the Hoshino Towns: Sho pagodas, an octagonal three-storey pagoda and spired halls among pines. Spectral ghosts may wander into frame.

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up 40 m south of the village pagoda from 3 m to 42 m with the gimbal held 10 degrees up, so the pagoda roof sinks and the fortress walls rise above it; keep 6 m from the pine behind.
shots.notes: OPENING REVEAL (drone.boom-rise, keepAim off). From 3 m over the Hoshino Town lane 40 m SSW of the octagonal pagoda, the camera rises 39 m in 16 s with a fixed +10 deg tilt toward NNE: first the three tiered pagoda roofs fill the frame, then they sink to the bottom edge while the 31 m walls, gate houses and 60 m pagoda towers of the fortress appear on the plateau 100-170 m above (terrain LOS: walls visible above z 176-190 from this column). Ground 57.7 (WBT). shots.notes: SPECTRAL FX + LANDMARK (classic.orbit, assigned).
